metric_notes.wer: Uncapped utterance-level config-consistent Whisper large-v3 WER; insertions can make WER exceed 100%.
metric_notes.utmos: Non-intrusive predicted naturalness; it does not establish target-speaker or lexical correctness.
metric_notes.dnsmos_p808: DNSMOS P.808 is displayed at corpus level; per-case P.808 scores are not shown in these listening examples.
metric_notes.estoi: Intrusive intelligibility estimate against the clean target.

selection_protocol.common_filter: Trial identities and waveforms are unchanged from the frozen listening-case selection; displayed transcripts and WER are re-audited consistently with Whisper large-v3.
selection_protocol.evidence_repair: Wrong-speaker BSRNN-TSE case retained to expose candidate repair; large-v3 scores BSRNN-TSE/BSRNN-TSE-CDCS-5/Qwen-TSE-fixed-CSG at 144.44/11.11/0% WER.
selection_protocol.speaker_grounding: Ungrounded acoustic-switch collapse retained; fixed and adaptive CSG restore target-side speaker identity and lower large-v3 WER from 100% to 25%.
selection_protocol.content_grounding: Former lexical-drift player set retained as a listening control because large-v3 assigns every displayed output the exact target transcript.
selection_protocol.quality_grounding: Matched 0%-WER outputs retained to expose the fidelity–predicted-naturalness operating-point difference.
